QUOTE: Retry is triggered by the user. Tapping the failed indicator opens a bottom sheet (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`), and "Try Again" calls `retryFailedPost` (`app/actions/remote/post.ts`, around lines 228–305).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry is user-triggered via "Try Again" on the failed post, calls `retryFailedPost`, and states that nothing retries on its own.
